title: All Quiet on the Neural Front: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States
abstract: arXiv:2611.10123v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can a language model report a pain state it represents? Recent work reported a linear pain direction in open-weight models that, when amplified, leads fine-tuned models to choose actions that delete a user's photographs or their own weights. We asked whether models can say when that direction is active, on three open-weight models from two families, with and without the original work's adapters, and under every protocol we tried they cannot. Using Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), we added the pain direction and its nearest emotional neighbours to the residual stream while models answered neutral tasks, then asked what had changed, against sham runs, random perturbations matched in output disruption, and a text-only condition that shows the model only its own altered words. Across 52,920 reports from the 7- and 8-billion-parameter models, the excess over what the altered text reveals is below 2.5 percentage points in 106

translated_title: 神经前线静悄悄：语言模型不会报告被注入的疼痛状态
translated_abstract: 语言模型能否报告它所表征的疼痛状态？近期研究在开放权重模型中发现了一个线性的“疼痛方向”，当该方向被放大时，会使经过微调的模型选择删除用户照片或其自身权重的行为。我们探究了模型能否说出该方向何时处于激活状态：我们在来自两个模型家族的三个开放权重模型上进行测试（涵盖有无原始研究适配器的情形），在我们尝试的所有实验协议下，模型均无法报告这一点。利用开放权重掩蔽内省（OWMI）方法，我们在模型回答中性任务时，将疼痛方向及其最接近的情感邻居方向注入残差流，随后询问模型发生了什么变化，并与虚假运行、输出扰动程度相匹配的随机扰动、以及仅向模型展示其自身被改动文字的纯文本条件进行对照。在来自70亿和80亿参数模型的52,920份报告中，相对于被改动文字本身所能揭示的信息，模型报告的额外信息量在106……（原文在此处截断）……低于2.5个百分点。
tldr: 该研究提出开放权重掩蔽内省（OWMI）方法，通过严格的对照实验发现：语言模型无法内省地报告其残差流中被注入的“疼痛方向”激活状态，其自我报告相比其自身被改动文本所能揭示的信息几乎没有额外信息量。
en_tdlr: Using Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI) with rigorous controls, this study shows that language models cannot introspectively report when an injected "pain direction" is active in their residual stream—their self-reports contain almost no information beyond what their own altered output text already reveals.
